# Packages
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(phangorn)
```

# Read and prepare data
## Read in files
```{r}
# taxonomy, abundance (DADA2 sequence table), and sample metadata
taxa <- read.table(file = 'FF_taxonomy.tabular', sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

abundance <- read.table(file = 'FF_abundance.dada2_sequencetable', sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

metadata <- read_excel("FF_metadata.xlsx") %>%
  filter(existing == "yes")

```

## Rarefaction curves
```{r, eval = FALSE}
rarecurve(t(abundance), step = 500) # all samples

abundance_controls <- abundance %>% select(contains("E")) # negative controls only
rarecurve(t(abundance_controls), step = 25)

rm(abundance_controls)
```



```{r}
# taxa: clean column names
colnames(taxa) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")

# abundance: clean column names (strip leading "X" from sample IDs)
colnames(abundance) <- substring(colnames(abundance), 2)

# metadata: set factors, recode layers, derive ratios and grouping variables
metadata <- metadata %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("nr") %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_exch"), as.numeric),
    p_total_citrate = as.numeric(p_total_citrate),
    replicate       = factor(replicate),
    layer = case_when(
      layer == "A (0-5cm)"   ~ "A5",
      layer == "A (5-10cm)"  ~ "A10",
      layer == "A (10-20cm)" ~ "A20",
      TRUE                   ~ str_to_title(layer)
    ),
    site  = factor(site,  levels = c("Bad Brückenau", "Mitterfels", "Kandel")),
    code  = factor(code,  levels = c("BBR", "MIT", "KAN")),
    layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "Oh",
                                     "A5", "A10", "A20")),
    nr         = row.names(metadata),
    type       = paste(code, "_", layer),
    qpit       = interaction(code, replicate),
    ff_type    = if_else(code == "BBR", "mull", "moder"),
    superlayer = case_when(
      layer %in% c("Ol0", "Ol1")     ~ "OL",
      layer %in% c("Olf", "Ohf")     ~ "OF",
      layer == "Oh"                  ~ "OH",
      layer %in% c("A5", "A10", "A20") ~ "A",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    ),
    CN = TOC / N_tot,
    CP = TOC / P_tot
  )

# taxa: shorten long names, fill missing ranks, resolve ambiguous labels
taxa <- taxa %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = if_else(Genus == "Allorhizobium-Neorhizobium-Pararhizobium-Rhizobium",
                    "Rhizobium", Genus),
    Order   = if_else(str_starts(Order,   "Subgroup"), paste(Phylum, Order),   Order),
    Family  = if_else(str_starts(Family,  "Subgroup") & !str_detect(Family,  "Subgroup "), paste(Order,  Family),  Family),
    Genus   = if_else(str_starts(Genus,   "Subgroup") & !str_detect(Genus,   "Subgroup "), paste(Family, Genus),   Genus),
    Species = if_else(str_starts(Species, "Subgroup") & !str_detect(Species, "Subgroup "), paste(Genus,  Species), Species),
    Kingdom = replace_na(Kingdom, "Unknown Kingdom"),
    Phylum  = replace_na(Phylum,  "unknown Phylum"),
    Class   = if_else(Phylum == "unknown Phylum", "unknown Phylum", coalesce(Class,  paste(Phylum, "C."))),
    Order   = if_else(Phylum == "unknown Phylum", "unknown Phylum", coalesce(Order,  paste(Class,  "O."))),
    Family  = if_else(Phylum == "unknown Phylum", "unknown Phylum", coalesce(Family, paste(Order,  "F."))),
    Genus   = if_else(Phylum == "unknown Phylum", "unknown Phylum", coalesce(Genus,  paste(Family, "G."))),
    Species = case_when(
      Phylum == "unknown Phylum"         ~ "unknown Phylum",
      !is.na(Species) & !is.na(Genus)   ~ paste(Genus, Species),
      TRUE                              ~ coalesce(Species, paste(Genus, "Sp."))
    )
  )
```


## Decontamination
```{r}
# record taxa/read counts before decontamination
reads_before <- colSums(abundance)
taxa_before <- nrow(abundance)

# remove contaminants by prevalence (negative controls flagged via "E" columns)
abundance = abundance[!decontam::isContaminant(t(abundance),
                                   neg = c(colnames(abundance)
                                           %in% colnames(abundance %>% dplyr::select(contains("E")))) ,
                                   method = "prevalence",
                                   threshold = 0.05,
                                   normalize = T,
                                   detailed = F), ]

# counts after decontamination and loss summary
reads_after <- colSums(abundance)
taxa_after <- nrow(abundance)

taxa_before - taxa_after
100 - (taxa_after/taxa_before)*100
100 - (sum(reads_after)/sum(reads_before))*100
```

## Removal of negative controls
```{r}
abundance <- abundance %>% dplyr::select(!contains("E"))
```

## Removal of mitochondrial and chloroplast sequences
```{r}
# record counts before filtering
reads_before <- colSums(abundance)
taxa_before <- nrow(abundance)

# drop chloroplast, mitochondria, eukaryote, and unassigned sequences
abundance <- abundance %>%
  filter(rownames(.) %in% rownames(taxa %>%
                      filter(!Order %in% "Chloroplast" &
                               !Family %in% "Mitochondria" &
                               !is.na(Kingdom) &
                               Kingdom != "Eukaryota")))

# counts after filtering and loss summary
reads_after <- colSums(abundance)
taxa_after <- nrow(abundance)

taxa_before - taxa_after
100 - (taxa_after/taxa_before)*100
100 - (sum(reads_after)/sum(reads_before))*100


rm(reads_before, reads_after, taxa_after, taxa_before)
```

# Creation of phyloseq object
```{r}
# load and midpoint-root the phylogenetic tree
load("FF_tree.RData")
tree_rooted <- midpoint(tree)

# assemble phyloseq object from abundance, taxonomy, metadata, and tree
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(as.matrix(abundance), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
               tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)),
               sample_data(metadata),
               tree_rooted)

```

# Subsetting and normalising
```{r}
# keep an untouched copy of the full object
ps_full_raw <- ps

# remove the deepest A horizon (A20)
ps <- subset_samples(ps, layer != "A20")
# remove KAN replicate 1 as an outlier
ps <- subset_samples(ps, !grepl("KAN-1", sample))

# filter out rare taxa
ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 10, ps)

# attach reference sequences, tagged as ASVs
ps <- microbiome::add_refseq(ps, tag = "ASV")

# CSS normalization (keep a non-normalized copy)
ps_nonorm <- ps
ps <- phyloseq_transform_css(ps, norm = T, log = F)
# round to nearest integer
ps <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) round(x, 0))

# drop taxa with zero abundance after normalization
ps <- prune_taxa(apply(otu_table(ps), 1, function(x) sum(x > 0)) >= 1, ps)
```
